proposal: IEC low-load extension to reach <= 35 % plant load; as part of the power island scope (back-to-back PG-11).
question: With the GT minimum emissions-compliant load of 40 % (DS-101), case SRC-NG-MEL gives 274.3 MW net = 44.7 % of the SRC net output, against PG-11 (<= 40 % of plant net output). Please provide a lower MECL.
response: IEC includes the DLN-H2 low-load extension in the power island scope at no price change (back-to-back PG-11): MECL 30 % GT load with CO <= 30 mg/Nm3 at the stack (oxidation catalyst). PER-003 Rev A case SRC-NG-MEL at 30 % GT load: about 213 MW net = 34.8 % of the SRC net output. New IEC guarantee IG-08.
subject: Minimum environmental load: 44.7 % against PG-11 (40 %)
